intro: Beneath your feet lies Mazı Underground City, a rock settlement in Nevşehir province from the 4th century AD. It has four separate entrances, with stables, ovens and church spaces, and it is one of the uncrowded ones in Cappadocia.
history: Mazı is one of Cappadocia's underground cities. It has four separate entrances, and much of it is still unexcavated. Mangers for the stables, ovens and church spaces are cut into the rock. And when danger came? Rolling stone doors closed the passages.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the four entrances, the stables and their mangers, the rolling stone doors and the church space.
facts: Did you know? In these underground cities the stables are always on the top level: animals were hard to take down, and the air was better near the surface. This underground city has four separate entrances, and much of it is still unexcavated.
outro: This brings our tour of Mazı Underground City to an end. Please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Thank you for joining us below ground, and enjoy your visit.
